reference.title: Git Client Preferences
reference.shortdesc: The options available in the main Git Client preferences page.

section.title: Overview
section.p:
To open the Git Client preferences pages, go to
, or select from the Vertical Ellipsis menu.

proptype.uicontrol: When detecting a Git repository inside a newly opened project

property.propdesc: Controls what happens to the current working copy when you open a project that contains a Git repository: Always switch to the new working copy, Never switch to the new working copy, or Always ask.

proptype.uicontrol: Check for local branches whose remote branch no longer exists

property.propdesc: Checks for local branches whose remote branch was deleted and offers to remove them. Clear this option to stop the check and its Outdated branches detected notification. You can also turn it off from the notification's Don't show this again checkbox.

proptype.uicontrol: Notify me about new commits in the remote repository

property.propdesc: Shows a notification when the remote repository has new commits.

proptype.uicontrol: Update all submodules after pulling changes from the remote repository

property.propdesc: Updates all submodules whenever you pull.

proptype.uicontrol: Detect and open Oxygen projects (.xpr) from opened working copies

property.propdesc: Opens an project found in a working copy. If one .xpr file is found, it opens automatically. If several are found, you choose which one to open.

Validates each file before it is committed and stops the commit if problems are found. Select Allow commit despite validation problems to add a Commit anyway button to the dialog box. For details, see .

proptype.uicontrol: Validate all files from the project's "Main Files" folder before pushing

property.propdesc: Validates the files in the Main Files folder before a push. Select Allow push despite validation problems to add a Push anyway button to the dialog box. For details, see .
Choose to store these settings in the project file (.xpr) so you can share them with your team.
